description: This file defines classes and methods for handling scheduler metrics and per-cell metrics in a wireless communication system, including tracking various UE and cell statistics, and interfacing with other scheduler components.

classes.name: cell_metrics_handler
classes.description: Handles scheduler slot metrics for a specific cell, tracking UE and cell statistics, and reporting metrics.

classes.name: scheduler_metrics_handler
classes.description: Manages metrics handlers for all cells in the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation
methods.description: Registers creation of a UE in the cell metrics handler.

methods.name: handle_ue_deletion
methods.description: Removes a UE from the cell metrics handler.

methods.name: handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Registers CRC indication for a slot.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indication for the cell.

methods.name: push_result
methods.description: Stores scheduler result for a slot.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Checks if metrics reporting is active.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell metrics handler to the scheduler.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses the metrics handler for a specific cell.
